description: Start a vibelive host session wrapping an agent command (e.g. ["claude"] or ["python","-i"]). Returns the ws:// join URL that other participants can connect to with `vibelive join`. The host process is authoritative.

command.description: The agent command to wrap, argv-style, e.g. ["claude"] or ["python","-i"].

name.description: Optional display name for the host participant.

name: host_session
title: Host a vibelive session
